playstyle: Aggressive Wing Chun: lightning-fast counter-hit strings, parries and Hermit (HRM) stance mix-ups. Fish with his CH jab and mid strings, parry the opponent's answers, and use Hermit's auto low parry. Wavu notes his normal-stance lows mostly exist to get into Hermit, not for damage.

stances.name: Hermit
stances.note: Hermit auto-parries lows and can stay in stance; HRM.1 is a Heat Engager. HRM.1,2 and HRM.2,3 appear in his combos.

keyMoves: Fast check; 1,2,4 is his i10 punish (Wavu).
i10 string into Hermit, -9 on block.
His i10 punish and a stance entry.
i13 mid, -6 on block; the df+1 string is a counter-hit tool (Wavu).
Outcast Arrow: i12 mid, launches on counter hit (+60a), -10 on block.
Hermit's Fist: i13 high, -6 on block; becomes Knee Snap on a grounded counter hit.
A fast high with a CH throw.
Beheading Back Kick: i22 homing high, +9 on block.
Chakra Elbow: i16 high, -6 on block, launches (+29a).
A safe launcher and combo starter.
Arrow Shower: i15 while-standing launcher, -14 on block.
Amputation Kick: i20 low, -8 on block, enters Hermit.
Fan Sweep: i17 low, -15 on block, knocks down on counter hit.
Parry against highs and mids (Wavu); perfect timing gives a stronger follow-up.
As a read on the opponent's attacks.
Parries also restore Heat in Heat (Wavu).
Chanhui Zhang: i17 mid Heat Engager, -4 on block.
i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
